window: Covering reporting published in the past 24-48 hours (Aug 31-Sep 1). Search indexes lag, so several items describe seizures or operations carried out a few days to a few weeks earlier; each story states its own incident date. Coverage of DEA, CBP, DOJ and USCG press releases and US local police blotters was unusually thin today — most candidates found were duplicates of stories already logged in prior editions or too stale to include, so both US sections render as "Nothing significant."

stories.summary: Bolivia's anti-narcotics force FELCN ran three checks in Santa Cruz department on August 30-31 as part of the "Frontera Segura" border plan.

stories.headline: Malaysia and Thailand — tea-bag meth ring rolled up after cross-border police tip-off
stories.summary: Thai police seized about 166 kilograms of methamphetamine from a Malaysian courier in Hua Hin on August 8 and passed the lead to Malaysian counterparts.
stories.location: Penang, Malaysia and Hua Hin, Thailand
